summary: The existing complete SVG workspace adopter names public 0.10–0.13 retained baselines; a separate historical typed-SDD0.13 receiver promises the same preserving transaction. The current0.19.3 reference adds modules behind file-existence guards, so a successful generic build alone can silently omit FourD, external-authority or WASM functionality. The selected successor manifest inherits the historical manifest by exact SHA256, retains its baseline archive/path allowlists and adds explicit current reference coverage with canonical hashes from declared immutable public source7be0bcf5. The copied-receiver harness checks preservation, managed/new-reference conflicts, interrupted apply and interrupted explicit rollback while leaving an adopted tree for subsequent qualification. Pure copied-source controls establish source behavior only: no actual template engine, downloaded archive, locked/Fable build or browser acceptance is established. Exact archive-to-materialized-tree joins and the promised retained runtime matrix remain open under .github#4816; clean installed-C acceptance does not transfer to these upgrades. The transaction helper is packed verbatim into PortalExample/manage.py, so source changes require refreshing its projected-helper provenance digest and preserving the existing Portal controls. No blanket template upgrade, lifecycle migration, product adoption or native authority is added.
title: Current reference upgrades need explicit target coverage as well as transaction recovery
